info.name: UniversalPOS API
info.description:
Every route the API serves, generated from the route table (`corepack pnpm postman`).

1. Import this collection and the "UniversalPOS local" environment; select the environment.
2. Run "1. Sign-in & public > POST /api/auth/platform/login" -- it saves {{platformToken}}.
3. Run "GET /plans" (saves {{planVersionId}}), then "POST /tenants" to create a restaurant (saves {{tenantId}}, {{tenantSlug}}, {{subscriptionId}}, {{inviteToken}}). Change the slug and email in its body first -- each must be unique.
4. Run "POST /api/auth/invite/accept" to set the manager password, then "POST /api/auth/:tenantSlug/login" -- it saves {{tenantToken}}.
5. Everything under "3. Restaurant" now runs as that restaurant.

Access tokens last 15 minutes; run the matching refresh request when you get 401.

request.description:

Permission: `platform.tenant.provision`

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('tenantId', b.tenantId); pm.collectionVariables.set('subscriptionId', b.subscriptionId); pm.collectionVariables.set('inviteToken', b.inviteToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('tenantSlug', JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw).slug);

Saves the Basic plan's id and newest version as {{planId}} / {{planVersionId}}.

Permission: `platform.plan.view`

exec: const basic = (b.plans ?? b).find?.((p) => p.key === 'basic'); if (basic) { pm.collectionVariables.set('planId', basic.planId); const v = [...basic.versions].sort((x, y) => y.version - x.version)[0]; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('planVersionId', v.planVersionId); }
